items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction (never move). E places a bomb. Space CONFIRMED INERT even with Tech X held (Tech X is passive) - ITEM=Space wall hint leads nowhere this run; Q also inert earlier. Death state shows a bloodied X-eyed body with all heart outlines empty.

TECH X (observed): obtained from the green/white pill floating above the two-poop room's central rock (earlier also from a red treasure chest); it sat right at the top-hatch landing point. Grants goggles, persists across rooms. Firing spawns a laser ring ahead that lingers, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. Ring offset is unreliable: consistently ~0.10-0.11 of room width left of the player when firing left (plus small varying vertical offset); precise aiming impossible, so reposition the player rather than hold fire. ~0.8-1.5s sustained fire per target. Destroys brown poop piles (drops a coin), cracks rocks/chests (red crack outlines). Destroyed the two-poop room's central rock - no passage revealed. NO effect on: golden coin object, golden wall fixture (tested at closest ever alignment, player x0.27 vs fixture x0.20 - no cracks), hopper's spiky shell (hopper burst out and cost a heart), red-lidded/key-locked chests. Torch-room central chest got cracks but never opened. Room objects REGENERATE on re-entry (central rock and poop piles reappear), so grinding a room's props is not persistent.

COINS (observed): the small golden '$'-faced round object dropped where a poop pile dies IS a coin; collect by near-exact overlap while walking (coins 00->01). Laser ignores coins. Faint gold specks/motes elsewhere are likely decorative.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by firing into them or by contact once enemies are dead; drops include a heart+bomb orb and a heart; a heart at full hearts converted to +1 bomb. Torch room's central gray chest embedded in a rock ring resists contact (no enemies alive) and laser; ring rocks seem to regenerate; likely key-locked, keys HUD stuck 00. Dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests resisted many laser hits (key/mimic guess); central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed; a corner chest contact cost several hearts at once (mimic/spike guess, unconfirmed).

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast damages the player - a 0.5s retreat was not enough, retreat far. Bomb inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but cost a heart. Bombing the white spike ring removed no spikes. Bombing cracked/stained wall patterns did nothing (decorative).

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders in the dark chest room are melee chasers and lethal - they drained the final heart at the tutorial right doorway (hazard reaches the doorway). White round-faced hoppers in the rock-field room are extremely dangerous: teleport/phase around, ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and green blobs that damage on contact; shells are unstable (hopper burst free and walked, then re-shelled) and lasering a shelled hopper costs a heart. Corner torches damage on contact. Diagonal rock chains block both straight and diagonal movement; pure single-axis moves work better; when wedged, one pure single-axis escape into open floor. Hazards cost 1-3 hearts per contact.

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend with centered sustained S; top crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W; trapezoid doorways are ordinary connections needing sustained walking and fairly precise centering. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid -> rock-field room; tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room; torch room TOP alcove -> TUTORIAL room (loop; needs tight x~0.50 centering); torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch -> torch room; tutorial RIGHT-WALL doorway (vertical band ~y0.47, must be near the doorway's vertical center) -> dark chest room. MAP CORRECTION: rock-field room's BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room's TOP alcove (not the tutorial room). Torch room's right-wall marking (~x0.79, y0.33-0.55) is DECORATIVE - pushes at many heights failed.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (wall hints, top+bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway y~0.47). Bottom -> torch room (central gray chest in triangular rock ring, four corner torches, brown poop pile, top alcove back to tutorial, bottom gold trapdoor). Bottom -> two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles - right one destructible, left one is a dark blob that absorbed many hits and never broke, Tech X pill, top crown hatch). Tutorial top -> rock-field room (many gray rocks, golden wall fixture on left wall ~x0.20,y0.50, hoppers, bottom trapezoid). Tutorial right -> dark chest room (corner red-lidded chests, spike-ringed central red chest, black spiders).

GOLDEN WALL FIXTURE (unresolved): rock-field room left wall; contact does nothing; laser at closest alignment did nothing - likely decorative or needs a non-laser trigger.

UNEXPLORED: rock-field room's TOP trapezoid door (main untested exit, center ~x0.50,y0.17); whether anything opens the two locked chest types; any source of keys (HUD always 00); where health drops come from (cleared rooms rarely drop hearts).

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/laser-opening locked or mimic chests without keys; firing while too close (ring overshoots); bombing spike rings and decorative wall cracks; lingering near hoppers/green clouds/spiders at low health; lasering a shelled hopper expecting a kill; assuming an open-looking lane is clear; hugging corner torches; retrying Space/Q; treating gold specks as pickups; grinding room props (they regenerate); entering the dark chest room or rock-field room under 2 hearts; wandering into rooms without a plan (death came from backtracking at 1 heart).

OPEN QUESTIONS: what opens the torch-room central chest and the dark-room red chests; what the golden wall fixture is; whether keys exist at all; what lies beyond the rock-field room's top door; how to regain health.
